description: Cohiba Magicos #103 image refresh. Synthetic catalog imagery generated from archived source references; not a photograph of the shop’s stock. Reviewed on 2026-10-26. Deployment state and verification evidence are maintained in docs/seo-13-magicos-implementation.md.

source_evidence.source_note: Cigar band confirms Cohiba Maduro 5; one single cigar, not a tube/composite.

generation.method: built-in image_gen edit; transparent foreground layer
generation.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: transparent product foreground layer for a square e-commerce catalog image
Input images: Image 1 is the exact product identity source. Image 2 is only a guide for upright orientation, scale, and catalog framing.
Primary request: Create a clean isolated transparent-background cutout of exactly one Cohiba Maduro 5 Mágicos cigar, upright and centered, cap at top and foot at bottom. Match the product appearance in Image 1 as faithfully as possible.
Subject: Preserve the single cigar's actual silhouette, dark Maduro wrapper, cap and foot, and all visible Cohiba / Habana Cuba / Maduro 5 bands and lettering. Do not add, remove, replace, reinterpret, or mirror any product details.
Composition/framing: Square transparent canvas; entire cigar visible with a small clear margin, approximately 78% of canvas height; straight vertical alignment.
Style/medium: Photorealistic catalog product layer, natural cigar texture, faithful color.
Constraints: The output must have true transparent pixels everywhere outside the cigar. Do not include any background, white matte, floor, shadow, reflection, watermark, logo, letters, props, box, smoke, or other cigar. Image 1 takes priority for exact product identity.
generation.postprocess: Deterministic FFmpeg composition by scripts/storefront_image_export.mjs; no product reconstruction in postprocess.
